name: trace_eq_zero_of_sq_algebraMap_of_not_mem_range
statement:
private theorem trace_eq_zero_of_sq_algebraMap_of_not_mem_range {F L : Type*} [Field F] [Field L]
    [Algebra F L] [FiniteDimensional F L] {x : L} {r : F}
    (hx2 : x ^ 2 = algebraMap F L r) (hx : x ∉ (algebraMap F L).range) :
    Algebra.trace F L x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmonic : (X ^ 2 - C r).Monic := Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C r (by norm_num)
  have haeval : aeval x (X ^ 2 - C r : F[X]) = 0 := by simp [hx2]
  have hdvd : minpoly F x ∣ (X ^ 2 - C r) := minpoly.dvd F x haeval
  have hint : IsIntegral F x := Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x
  have hne : (X ^ 2 - C r : F[X]) ≠ 0 := Polynomial.X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero (by norm_num) r
  have hdeg2 : (minpoly F x).natDegree = 2 := by
    have hle : (minpoly F x).natDegree ≤ 2 := by
      have := Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd hdvd hne
      simpa [Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_sub_C] using this
    have hge : 2 ≤ (minpoly F x).natDegree := by
      by_contra h
      rw [not_le] at h
      interval_cases hh : (minpoly F x).natDegree
      · exact (minpoly.natDegree_pos hint).ne' hh
      · exact hx (minpoly.natDegree_eq_one_iff.mp hh)
    omega
  have heq : minpoly F x = X ^ 2 - C r :=
    (Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le (minpoly.monic hint) hmonic hdvd
      (by rw [hdeg2, Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_sub_C])).symm
  rw [trace_eq_finrank_mul_minpoly_nextCoeff, heq]
  have hnc : (X ^ 2 - C r : F[X]).nextCoeff = 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos
      (by rw [Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_sub_C]; norm_num)]
    simp [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  rw [hnc]; simp

    {x : K} {r : ℚ} (hx2 : x ^ 2 = algebraMap ℚ K r)
    (hx : x ∉ (algebraMap ℚ K).range) :
    Algebra.trace ℚ K x = 0

lemma coeff_pushforward [DecidableEq Y] (f : X → Y) (D : WeilDivisor X) (y : Y) :
    coeff (pushforward f D) y = ∑ x ∈ D.support with f x = y, coeff D x
proof:
:= by
  rcases em (y ∈ Set.range f) with ⟨x, rfl⟩ | hy
  · simp [coeff, Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_eq_sum]
  · rw [coeff, pushforward_apply, Finsupp.mapDomain_notin_range]
    · refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => ?_).symm
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
      exact (hy ⟨x, hx.2⟩).elim
    · exact hy

name: IsEffective.weightedDegree_nonneg
statement:
lemma IsEffective.weightedDegree_nonneg {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x)
    {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) : 0 ≤ weightedDegree w D
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedDegree_apply]
  exact Finsupp.sum_nonneg fun x _ => mul_nonneg (hD x) (hw x)

name: IsEffective.weightedDegree_eq_zero_iff_of_pos
statement:
lemma IsEffective.weightedDegree_eq_zero_iff_of_pos {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) :
    weightedDegree w D = 0 ↔ D = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hdeg
    by_contra hD0
    obtain ⟨x, hxpos⟩ := hD.exists_pos_coeff_of_ne_zero hD0
    have hsum_pos : 0 < D.sum fun y n => n * w y := by
      exact Finsupp.sum_pos' (fun y _ => mul_nonneg (hD y) (le_of_lt (hw y)))
        ⟨x, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr (ne_of_gt hxpos), mul_pos hxpos (hw x)⟩
    rw [← weightedDegree_apply] at hsum_pos
    exact (ne_of_gt hsum_pos) hdeg
  · intro h
    simp [h]

name: IsEffective.eq_zero_of_weightedDegree_eq_zero_of_pos
statement:
lemma IsEffective.eq_zero_of_weightedDegree_eq_zero_of_pos {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) (hdeg : weightedDegree w D = 0) : D = 0

name: IsEffective.weightedDegree_pos_of_pos
statement:
lemma IsEffective.weightedDegree_pos_of_pos {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) (hD0 : D ≠ 0) :
    0 < weightedDegree w D
proof:
:= by
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hD.weightedDegree_nonneg fun x => le_of_lt (hw x)) fun h =>
    hD0 ((hD.weightedDegree_eq_zero_iff_of_pos hw).mp h.symm)

name: coeff_pointDifference
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_pointDifference [DecidableEq X] (x y z : X) :
    coeff (pointDifference x y) z =
      (if z = x then 1 else 0) - (if z = y then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : z = x
  · by_cases hy : z = y
    · subst hx
      subst hy
      simp [pointDifference, ofPoint, coeff]
    · subst hx
      simp [pointDifference, ofPoint, coeff, hy]
  · by_cases hy : z = y
    · subst hy
      simp [pointDifference, ofPoint, coeff, hx]
    · simp [pointDifference, ofPoint, coeff, hx, hy]

name: support_pointDifference_subset
statement:
lemma support_pointDifference_subset [DecidableEq X] (x y : X) :
    (pointDifference x y).support ⊆ {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  by_contra hzy
  push Not at hzy
  have hx : z ≠ x := hzy.1
  have hy : z ≠ y := hzy.2
  exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hz)
    (by simp [pointDifference, ofPoint, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hx, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hy])

name: algHom_comp_convMul_ofConv
statement:
private lemma algHom_comp_convMul_ofConv (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) (f g : A →ₗ[R] A) :
    (toConv (φ.toLinearMap.comp f) *
          toConv (φ.toLinearMap.comp g)).ofConv =
      φ.toLinearMap.comp (toConv f * toConv g).ofConv
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : φ.toLinearMap = (φ : A →ₐ[R] B).toLinearMap :=
    (toAlgHom_toLinearMap φ).symm
  rw [hφ]
  simpa using
    (LinearMap.algHom_comp_convMul_distrib (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (toConv f) (toConv g)).symm

name: convMul_comp_coalgHom_ofConv
statement:
private lemma convMul_comp_coalgHom_ofConv (f g : B →ₗ[R] B) (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) :
    (toConv (f.comp φ.toLinearMap) *
          toConv (g.comp φ.toLinearMap)).ofConv =
      (toConv f * toConv g).ofConv.comp φ.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : φ.toLinearMap = ((φ : A →ₗc[R] B) : A →ₗ[R] B) :=
    (coe_coalgHom_toLinearMap φ).symm
  rw [hφ]
  simpa using
    (LinearMap.convMul_comp_coalgHom_distrib (toConv f) (toConv g)
      (φ : A →ₗc[R] B)).symm

name: algHom_comp_antipode_id_ofConv
statement:
private lemma algHom_comp_antipode_id_ofConv (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) :
    (toConv (φ.toLinearMap.comp (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := A))) *
          toConv φ.toLinearMap).ofConv =
      φ.toLinearMap.comp
        (toConv (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := A)) * toConv LinearMap.id).ofConv
proof:
:= by
  have h := algHom_comp_convMul_ofConv φ (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := A)) LinearMap.id
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_id] using h

name: id_antipode_comp_coalgHom_ofConv
statement:
private lemma id_antipode_comp_coalgHom_ofConv (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) :
    (toConv φ.toLinearMap *
          toConv ((HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := B)).comp φ.toLinearMap)).ofConv =
      (toConv LinearMap.id * toConv (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := B))).ofConv.comp
        φ.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have h := convMul_comp_coalgHom_ofConv (LinearMap.id : B →ₗ[R] B)
    (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := B)) φ
  simpa only [LinearMap.id_comp] using h

name: toLinearMap_comp_antipode
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toLinearMap_comp_antipode (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) :
    φ.toLinearMap.comp (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := A)) =
      (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := B)).comp φ.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  let f : WithConv (A →ₗ[R] B) := toConv φ.toLinearMap
  let g : WithConv (A →ₗ[R] B) :=
    toConv (φ.toLinearMap.comp (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := A)))
  let h : WithConv (A →ₗ[R] B) :=
    toConv ((HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := B)).comp φ.toLinearMap)
  have hg_left : g * f = 1 := by
    refine WithConv.ofConv_injective ?_
    dsimp [g, f]
    rw [toCoalgHom_toLinearMap φ]
    rw [algHom_comp_antipode_id_ofConv φ]
    rw [HopfAlgebra.antipode_convMul_id]
    ext a
    exact (φ : A →ₐ[R] B).commutes (Coalgebra.counit a)
  have hh_right : f * h = 1 := by
    refine WithConv.ofConv_injective ?_
    dsimp [f, h]
    rw [toCoalgHom_toLinearMap φ]
    rw [id_antipode_comp_coalgHom_ofConv φ]
    rw [HopfAlgebra.id_convMul_antipode]
    ext a
    exact congr_arg (algebraMap R B) (CoalgHomClass.counit_comp_apply φ a)
  have h_eq : g = h := by
    calc
      g = g * 1 := by rw [mul_one]
      _ = g * (f * h) := by rw [hh_right]
      _ = (g * f) * h := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 * h := by rw [hg_left]
      _ = h := by rw [one_mul]
  exact WithConv.toConv_injective h_eq

name: index_powMonoidHom_range_le_of_closure_eq_top
statement:
private theorem index_powMonoidHom_range_le_of_closure_eq_top {G : Type*} [CommGroup G]
    {S : Finset G} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hS : Subgroup.closure (S : Set G) = ⊤) :
    (powMonoidHom n : G →* G).range.index ≤ n ^ S.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set H := (powMonoidHom n : G →* G).range with hH
  haveI : Group.FG G := Group.fg_iff'.mpr ⟨S.card, S, rfl, hS⟩
  haveI : Group.FG (G ⧸ H) := Group.fg_of_surjective (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective H)
  have hpow : ∀ q : G ⧸ H, q ^ n = 1 := fun q =>
    QuotientGroup.induction_on q fun g => by
      rw [← QuotientGroup.mk_pow, QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff]
      exact ⟨g, by rw [powMonoidHom_apply]⟩
  have hcard : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) ∣ n ^ Group.rank (G ⧸ H) :=
    card_dvd_exponent_pow_rank' (G ⧸ H) hpow
  have hrank : Group.rank (G ⧸ H) ≤ S.card :=
    (Group.rank_le_of_surjective (QuotientGroup.mk' H) (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective H)).trans
      (Group.rank_le hS)
  calc H.index
      = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := Subgroup.index_eq_card H
    _ ≤ n ^ Group.rank (G ⧸ H) := Nat.le_of_dvd (pow_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) _) hcard
    _ ≤ n ^ S.card := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) hrank

name: square_eq_powMonoidHom_two_range
statement:
private theorem square_eq_powMonoidHom_two_range {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] :
    Subgroup.square G = (powMonoidHom 2 : G →* G).range
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  rw [Subgroup.mem_square, MonoidHom.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨h, by rw [powMonoidHom_apply, sq]⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨h, by rw [powMonoidHom_apply, sq]⟩

name: point_unitOfPoint_single
statement:
private theorem point_unitOfPoint_single (f : R[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[R] A) (n : ℤ) :
    (unitOfPoint f ^ n).val = f (LaurentPolynomial.T n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [zpow_add, zpow_one, Units.val_mul, ih,
        unitOfPoint_val, ← map_mul, ← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]
  | pred n ih =>
      have ih' : ↑((unitOfPoint f ^ (n : ℤ))⁻¹) = f (LaurentPolynomial.T (-(n : ℤ))) := by
        simpa [zpow_neg] using ih
      have hinv : ↑(unitOfPoint f ^ (-1 : ℤ)) = f (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) := by
        simp [zpow_neg, unitOfPoint_inv (R := R) (A := A) f]
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, zpow_add, zpow_neg, Units.val_mul, ih', hinv, ← map_mul,
        ← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]

  rw [LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T, map_one, one_mul, point_T]

name: convInv_mul_cancel
statement: private lemma convInv_mul_cancel (f : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) : f⁻¹ * f = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  refine WithConv.ofConv_injective (AlgHom.toLinearMap_injective (WithConv.toConv_injective ?_))
  rw [AlgHom.toLinearMap_convMul, AlgHom.toLinearMap_convOne, convInv_def, toConv_ofConv,
    toLinearMap_antipodeComp]
  
  refine WithConv.ofConv_injective ?_
  
  have key := LinearMap.algHom_comp_convMul_distrib f.ofConv
    (toConv (antipode R)) (toConv LinearMap.id)
  
  rw [HopfAlgebra.antipode_convMul_id, ofConv_toConv, ofConv_toConv, LinearMap.comp_id] at key
  
  rw [← key, LinearMap.convOne_def, ofConv_toConv]
  
  ext h
  exact f.ofConv.commutes (counit h)

    mkQuotient H I ≫ liftQuotient I f hf = f
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  exact BialgHom.congr_fun
    (HopfIdeal.liftBialgHom_comp_mkBialgHom I (toBialgHom f) hf) h

name: liftQuotient_unique
statement:
lemma liftQuotient_unique (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (toBialgHom f).toAlgHom.toRingHom) (g : quotient H I ⟶ K)
    (hg : mkQuotient H I ≫ g = f) : g = liftQuotient I f hf
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_surjective R I.toIdeal q
  calc
    toBialgHom g (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
        toBialgHom (mkQuotient H I ≫ g) h := rfl
    _ = toBialgHom f h := by rw [hg]
    _ = toBialgHom (liftQuotient I f hf) (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) :=
      (liftQuotient_mk I f hf h).symm

name: liftEquiv_map_mul
statement:
private lemma liftEquiv_map_mul
    (f g : WithConv (A →ₐ[k] R)) :
    AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R
      (WithConv.ofConv (f * g)) =
    WithConv.ofConv
      ((WithConv.toConv (AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R f.ofConv) *
        WithConv.toConv (AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R g.ofConv)) :
          WithConv (K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R))
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  suffices
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift f.ofConv g.ofConv (fun _ _ => .all _ _))
        (Coalgebra.comul (R := k) a) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R f.ofConv)
        (AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R g.ofConv) (fun _ _ => .all _ _))
        ((AlgebraTensorModule.tensorTensorTensorComm k K k K K K A A)
          (1 ⊗ₜ[K] 1 ⊗ₜ[k] Coalgebra.comul (R := k) a)) by
    simpa only [AlgHom.coe_comp, AlgHom.coe_restrictScalars', Function.comp_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, AlgHom.liftEquiv_tmul, one_smul,
      AlgHom.convMul_apply, TensorProduct.comul_tmul, Bialgebra.comul_one,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def] using this
  induction Coalgebra.comul (R := k) a with
  | zero => simp only [tmul_zero, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [tmul_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | tmul a₁ a₂ =>
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul, AlgebraTensorModule.tensorTensorTensorComm_tmul,
        AlgHom.liftEquiv_tmul, Algebra.smul_def, map_one, one_mul]

name: mem_zpowers_generator
statement:
private lemma mem_zpowers_generator (n : ℕ) (x : Multiplicative (ZMod n)) :
    x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (generator n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(Multiplicative.toAdd x).cast, ?_⟩
  simp only [generator]
  rw [← ofAdd_zsmul]
  calc
    Multiplicative.ofAdd ((Multiplicative.toAdd x).cast • (1 : ZMod n)) =
        Multiplicative.ofAdd (((Multiplicative.toAdd x).cast : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by simp
    _ =
        Multiplicative.ofAdd (Multiplicative.toAdd x) := by rw [ZMod.intCast_zmod_cast]
    _ = x := ofAdd_toAdd x

proof:

    (Nat.card_zmod n)

      ((ζ : Aˣ) : A)

    ((characterMulEquivRootsOfUnity (A := A) n).symm ζ)]
  simp

name: pointsMulEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pointsMulEquiv_apply (n : ℕ)
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative (ZMod n)) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) n f : Aˣ) : A) =
      f.ofConv (MonoidAlgebra.single (generator n) 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointsMulEquiv, MulEquiv.trans_apply, DiagonalizableGroup.pointsMulEquiv_apply,
    characterMulEquivRootsOfUnity_apply]
  exact DiagonalizableGroup.charOfPoint_apply_coe f.ofConv (generator n)

proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | tmul m c => exact ⟨⟨m, Submodule.mem_top⟩ ⊗ₜ[R] c, by simp⟩

      rcases hx with ⟨x', rfl⟩

    TensorProduct.map (A.carrier.map f.toLinearMap).subtype (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C)

name: map_le_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h m hm
    exact h (mem_map_of_mem f hm)
  · intro h n hn
    rcases (mem_map (A := A) (f := f)).1 hn with ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    exact h hm

proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  rcases (mem_map (A := A) (f := f)).1 hn with ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  exact mem_map_of_mem f (hAB hm)

name: map_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_bot (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) : (⊥ : Subcomodule R C M).map f = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [mem_map, mem_bot]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_bot] at hm
    rw [hm]
    exact f.toLinearMap.map_zero
  · intro hn
    refine ⟨0, by rw [mem_bot], ?_⟩
    rw [hn]
    exact f.toLinearMap.map_zero

proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m', hm', h⟩
    exact h ▸ hm'
  · intro hm
    exact ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩

name: map_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_map (A : Subcomodule R C M) (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N)
    (g : Comodule.Hom R C N P) : (A.map f).map g = A.map (g.comp f)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rw [mem_map, mem_map]
    rintro ⟨n, ⟨m, hm, hmn⟩, hnp⟩
    refine ⟨m, hm, ?_⟩
    calc
      (g.comp f) m = g (f m) := by simp only [Comodule.Hom.comp_apply]
      _ = g n := congrArg g hmn
      _ = p := hnp
  · rw [mem_map]
    rintro ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    exact mem_map_of_mem g (mem_map_of_mem f hm)

theorem zero_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (m : M) :
    (0 : M ⟶ N) m = 0

name: add_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f g : M ⟶ N) (m : M) :
    (f + g) m = f m + g m

name: nsmul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nsmul_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (n : ℕ) (f : M ⟶ N) (m : M) :
    (n • f) m = n • f m

name: smul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (r : R) (f : M ⟶ N) (m : M) :
    (r • f) m = r • f m

name: sum_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_apply {ι : Type*} {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → (M ⟶ N)) (m : M) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) m = ∑ i ∈ s, f i m

name: add_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_comp {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f g : M ⟶ N) (h : N ⟶ P) :
    (f + g) ≫ h = f ≫ h + g ≫ h
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  exact map_add h.toLinearMap (f m) (g m)

name: comp_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_add {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : M ⟶ N) (g h : N ⟶ P) :
    f ≫ (g + h) = f ≫ g + f ≫ h

name: smul_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_comp {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (r : R) (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P) :
    (r • f) ≫ g = r • (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  exact map_smul g.toLinearMap r (f m)

name: comp_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_smul {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (r : R) (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P) :
    f ≫ (r • g) = r • (f ≫ g)

name: zero_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_comp {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : N ⟶ P) :
    (0 : M ⟶ N) ≫ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  exact map_zero f.toLinearMap

name: comp_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_zero {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    f ≫ (0 : N ⟶ P) = 0

name: forget
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forget₂_obj (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (forget₂ (ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{w} R)).obj M =
      SemimoduleCat.of R M

name: forget
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forget₂_map {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (forget₂ (ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{w} R)).map f =
      SemimoduleCat.ofHom f.toLinearMap

name: isoToLinearEquiv_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_toLinearMap {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) :
    (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).toLinearMap = i.hom.toLinearMap

name: isoToLinearEquiv_symm_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_symm_toLinearMap {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) :
    (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).symm.toLinearMap = i.inv.toLinearMap

name: isoToLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) (m : M) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i m = i.hom m

name: isoToLinearEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_symm_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N)
    (n : N) :
    (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).symm n = i.inv n

name: isoToLinearEquiv_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_refl (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (Iso.refl M) = LinearEquiv.refl R M

name: isoToLinearEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_symm {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i.symm =
      (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).symm

name: isoToLinearEquiv_trans
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_trans {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N)
    (j : N ≅ P) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (i ≪≫ j) =
      (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).trans
        (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) j)

name: isoOfLinearEquiv_hom_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_hom_toLinearMap {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C}
    (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (h) :
    ((isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) e h).hom).toLinearMap = e.toLinearMap

name: isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_toLinearMap {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C}
    (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (h) :
    ((isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) e h).inv).toLinearMap =
      e.symm.toLinearMap

name: isoOfLinearEquiv_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_hom_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C}
    (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (h) (m : M) :
    (isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) e h).hom m = e m

name: isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C}
    (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (h) (n : N) :
    (isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) e h).inv n = e.symm n

name: isoToLinearEquiv_isoOfLinearEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_isoOfLinearEquiv {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C}
    (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (h) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) e h) =
      e

name: isoOfLinearEquiv_isoToLinearEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_isoToLinearEquiv {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) :
    isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i)
      (by simp [i.hom.map_coact]) = i

name: mk
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply (R := R) (S := R), Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul,
    map_one,
    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hy, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]

name: mk
statement:
private theorem mkₐ₂_includeRight_eq_zero {y : H} (hy : y ∈ I.toIdeal) :
    mkₐ₂ I (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one,
    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hy, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]

name: leSup_le_ker_mk
proof:
:= by
  apply sup_le
  · rw [leftTensorIdeal_le_iff]
    intro y hy
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker]
    exact mkₐ₂_includeLeft_eq_zero I hy
  · rw [rightTensorIdeal_le_iff]
    intro y hy
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker]
    exact mkₐ₂_includeRight_eq_zero I hy

name: quotientComulAlgHom_comp_mk
quotientCounitAlgHom_comp_mk
quotientComulAlgHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientComulAlgHom_mk (h : H) :
    quotientComulAlgHom I (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h)
      = Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal) (Coalgebra.comul h)

name: quotientCounitAlgHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientCounitAlgHom_mk (h : H) :
    quotientCounitAlgHom I (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
      Coalgebra.counit (R := R) h

name: mkL_surjective
statement: private theorem mkL_surjective : Function.Surjective (mkL I)

name: comul_mkL_apply
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (quotientComulAlgHom I).toLinearMap (mkL I h)
        = quotientComulAlgHom I (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) := rfl
    _ = Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal) (Coalgebra.comul h) :=
      quotientComulAlgHom_mk I h
    _ = TensorProduct.map (mkL I) (mkL I) (Coalgebra.comul h) :=
      LinearMap.congr_fun
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.toLinearMap_map (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal)
          (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal)) _

name: comul_comp_mkL
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using comul_mkL_apply I h

name: counit_comp_mkL
statement:
private theorem counit_comp_mkL :
    (quotientCounitAlgHom I).toLinearMap ∘ₗ mkL I = Coalgebra.counit (R := R)
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  exact quotientCounitAlgHom_mk I h

name: linearMap_ext
statement:
private theorem linearMap_ext {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N]
    {f g : (H ⧸ I.toIdeal) →ₗ[R] N} (hfg : f ∘ₗ mkL I = g ∘ₗ mkL I) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun q => ?_
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := mkL_surjective I q
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hfg a

name: comul_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comul_mk (h : H) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h)
      = TensorProduct.map (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal).toLinearMap
        (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal).toLinearMap (Coalgebra.comul h)

name: counit_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem counit_mk (h : H) :
    Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
      Coalgebra.counit (R := R) h

name: quotientAntipodeLinearMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientAntipodeLinearMap_mk (h : H) :
    quotientAntipodeLinearMap I (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal (HopfAlgebra.antipode R h)

name: antipode_comp_mkL
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  exact quotientAntipodeLinearMap_mk I h

name: mul'_comp_map_mkL
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun a b => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.mul'_apply,
    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_mul]

name: mul'_map_mkL_apply
antipode_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem antipode_mk (h : H) :
    HopfAlgebra.antipode R (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal (HopfAlgebra.antipode R h)

name: mkBialgHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkBialgHom_apply (h : H) : mkBialgHom I h = Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h

name: liftBialgHom_kill
liftBialgHomAlg_mk
proof:
:= by
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun
    (Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ_comp I.toIdeal (f : H →ₐ[R] K)
      fun _ ha => liftBialgHom_kill I f hf ha) h

name: liftBialgHomAlg_toLinearMap_comp_mk
statement:
private theorem liftBialgHomAlg_toLinearMap_comp_mkₐ (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.toAlgHom.toRingHom) :
    (liftBialgHomAlg I f hf).toLinearMap.comp
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal).toLinearMap = f.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  exact liftBialgHomAlg_mk I f hf h

name: liftBialgHomAlg_comul_mk
statement:
private theorem liftBialgHomAlg_comul_mk (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.toAlgHom.toRingHom) (h : H) :
    TensorProduct.map (liftBialgHomAlg I f hf).toLinearMap
        (liftBialgHomAlg I f hf).toLinearMap
        (TensorProduct.map (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal).toLinearMap
          (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal).toLinearMap (Coalgebra.comul h)) =
      Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (f h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TensorProduct.map_map, liftBialgHomAlg_toLinearMap_comp_mkₐ]
  exact CoalgHomClass.map_comp_comul_apply f h

name: liftBialgHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftBialgHom_mk (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.toAlgHom.toRingHom) (h : H) :
    liftBialgHom I f hf (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) = f h
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftBialgHom]
  exact liftBialgHomAlg_mk I f hf h

name: liftBialgHom_comp_mkBialgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftBialgHom_comp_mkBialgHom (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.toAlgHom.toRingHom) :
    (liftBialgHom I f hf).comp (mkBialgHom I) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  simp only [BialgHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, mkBialgHom_apply, liftBialgHom_mk]

name: liftBialgHom_unique
statement:
theorem liftBialgHom_unique (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.toAlgHom.toRingHom) (g : H ⧸ I.toIdeal →ₐc[R] K)
    (hg : g.comp (mkBialgHom I) = f) :
    g = liftBialgHom I f hf
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_surjective R I.toIdeal q
  calc
    g (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) = (g.comp (mkBialgHom I)) h := rfl
    _ = f h := BialgHom.congr_fun hg h
    _ = liftBialgHom I f hf (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) :=
      (liftBialgHom_mk I f hf h).symm

name: quotientAntipodeAlgHom_comp_mk
quotientAntipodeAlgHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientAntipodeAlgHom_mk (h : H) :
    quotientAntipodeAlgHom I (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal (HopfAlgebra.antipode R h)

name: antipodeHom_
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem antipodeHom_ι (x : M) :
    antipodeHom R M (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x) =
      -(_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x)

name: antipode_
statement:
@[simp]
theorem antipode_ι (x : M) :
    antipode R (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x) = -(_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x)

name: lift_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_symm_apply (H : _root_.SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A) (x : M) :
    _root_.SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm H x = H (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x)
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← Equiv.apply_symm_apply _root_.SymmetricAlgebra.lift H]
  rw [_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]

name: convMul_apply_
statement:
@[simp]
theorem convMul_apply_ι (F G : WithConv (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) (x : M) :
    (F * G).ofConv (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x) =
      F.ofConv (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x) +
        G.ofConv (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.comul_ι, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul] using
    AlgHom.convMul_apply F G (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x)

name: leftTensorIdeal_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftTensorIdeal_def (I : Ideal H) :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I =
      Ideal.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom
        I

name: rightTensorIdeal_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightTensorIdeal_def (I : Ideal H) :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I =
      Ideal.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom I

name: includeLeft_mem_leftTensorIdeal
statement:
theorem includeLeft_mem_leftTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H) x ∈
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I

name: includeRight_mem_rightTensorIdeal
statement:
theorem includeRight_mem_rightTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H) x ∈
      rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I

name: tmul_mem_leftTensorIdeal
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_leftTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) (y : H) :
    x ⊗ₜ[R] y ∈ leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I
proof:
:= by
  have h : x ⊗ₜ[R] y =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H) y *
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H) x := by
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
  rw [h]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (includeLeft_mem_leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) hx)

name: tmul_mem_rightTensorIdeal
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_rightTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} (x : H) {y : H} (hy : y ∈ I) :
    x ⊗ₜ[R] y ∈ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I
proof:
:= by
  have h : x ⊗ₜ[R] y =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H) x *
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H) y := by
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
  rw [h]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (includeRight_mem_rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) hy)

name: mem_leftTensorIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_leftTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H ⊗[R] H} :
    x ∈ leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ↔
      x ∈ Ideal.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom
        I

name: mem_rightTensorIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_rightTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H ⊗[R] H} :
    x ∈ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ↔
      x ∈ Ideal.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom I

name: leftTensorIdeal_le_iff
statement:
theorem leftTensorIdeal_le_iff {I : Ideal H} {J : Ideal (H ⊗[R] H)} :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ≤ J ↔
      I ≤ Ideal.comap
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom
        J

name: rightTensorIdeal_le_iff
statement:
theorem rightTensorIdeal_le_iff {I : Ideal H} {J : Ideal (H ⊗[R] H)} :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ≤ J ↔
      I ≤ Ideal.comap
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom J

name: leftTensorIdeal_mono
statement:
theorem leftTensorIdeal_mono {I J : Ideal H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ≤ leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) J

name: rightTensorIdeal_mono
statement:
theorem rightTensorIdeal_mono {I J : Ideal H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ≤ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) J

name: leftTensorIdeal_iSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftTensorIdeal_iSup {ι : Sort*} (I : ι → Ideal H) :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (⨆ i, I i) =
      ⨆ i, leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (I i)
proof:
:=
  Ideal.map_iSup
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom I

name: rightTensorIdeal_iSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightTensorIdeal_iSup {ι : Sort*} (I : ι → Ideal H) :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (⨆ i, I i) =
      ⨆ i, rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (I i)

name: leftTensorIdeal_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftTensorIdeal_sup (I J : Ideal H) :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (I ⊔ J) =
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ⊔ leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) J
proof:
:=
  Ideal.map_sup
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom I J

name: rightTensorIdeal_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightTensorIdeal_sup (I J : Ideal H) :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (I ⊔ J) =
      rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ⊔ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) J
proof:
:=
  Ideal.map_sup
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom I J

name: le_leftTensorIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem le_leftTensorIdeal_iff {I : Ideal H} {J : Ideal (H ⊗[R] H)} :
    J ≤ leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ↔
      J ≤ Ideal.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom
        I

name: le_rightTensorIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem le_rightTensorIdeal_iff {I : Ideal H} {J : Ideal (H ⊗[R] H)} :
    J ≤ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ↔
      J ≤ Ideal.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom I

name: mem_carrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_carrier {I : HopfIdeal R H} {x : H} : x ∈ I.carrier ↔ x ∈ I

name: mem_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_toIdeal {I : HopfIdeal R H} {x : H} : x ∈ I.toIdeal ↔ x ∈ I

name: toIdeal_carrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toIdeal_carrier (I : HopfIdeal R H) : I.toIdeal = I.carrier

name: le_def
statement: theorem le_def {I J : HopfIdeal R H} : I ≤ J ↔ ∀ ⦃x : H⦄, x ∈ I → x ∈ J

name: toIdeal_le_toIdeal
statement:
theorem toIdeal_le_toIdeal {I J : HopfIdeal R H} :
    I.toIdeal ≤ J.toIdeal ↔ I ≤ J

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (h : ∀ x : H, x ∈ I ↔ x ∈ J) : I = J

name: ofIdeal_carrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofIdeal_carrier (I : Ideal H) [I.IsTwoSided] (hcomul hcounit hantipode) :
    (ofIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I hcomul hcounit hantipode).carrier = I

name: mem_ofIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_ofIdeal {I : Ideal H} [I.IsTwoSided] {hcomul hcounit hantipode} {x : H} :
    x ∈ ofIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I hcomul hcounit hantipode ↔ x ∈ I

name: comul_mem
statement:
theorem comul_mem (I : HopfIdeal R H) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) x ∈
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I.toIdeal ⊔
        rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I.toIdeal

name: counit_eq_zero
statement:
theorem counit_eq_zero (I : HopfIdeal R H) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    Coalgebra.counit (R := R) x = 0

name: antipode_mem
statement:
theorem antipode_mem (I : HopfIdeal R H) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    HopfAlgebra.antipode R x ∈ I

name: mul_mem_right
statement:
theorem mul_mem_right (I : HopfIdeal R H) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) (y : H) :
    x * y ∈ I

name: bot_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bot_toIdeal : (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H).toIdeal = (⊥ : Ideal H)

name: mem_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_bot {x : H} : x ∈ (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H) ↔ x = 0

name: sup_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_toIdeal (I J : HopfIdeal R H) : (I ⊔ J).toIdeal = I.toIdeal ⊔ J.toIdeal

name: mem_sup
statement:
theorem mem_sup {I J : HopfIdeal R H} {x : H} :
    x ∈ I ⊔ J ↔ ∃ y ∈ I, ∃ z ∈ J, y + z = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toIdeal, sup_toIdeal, Submodule.mem_sup]
  rfl

name: sSup_isTwoSided
statement:
private theorem sSup_isTwoSided (S : Set (HopfIdeal R H)) :
    (⨆ I : S, (I : HopfIdeal R H).toIdeal).IsTwoSided
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun {x} b hx => ?_⟩
  rw [Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  rw [Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun I _ =>
    Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem I ((I : HopfIdeal R H).mul_mem_right (hf I) b)

name: comul_mem_sSup
statement:
private theorem comul_mem_sSup (S : Set (HopfIdeal R H)) {x : H}
    (hx : x ∈ ⨆ I : S, (I : HopfIdeal R H).toIdeal) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) x ∈
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (⨆ I : S, (I : HopfIdeal R H).toIdeal) ⊔
        rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (⨆ I : S, (I : HopfIdeal R H).toIdeal)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  rw [Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun I _ => ?_
  exact sup_le_sup
    (leftTensorIdeal_mono (R := R) (H := H)
      (le_iSup (fun I : S => (I : HopfIdeal R H).toIdeal) I))
    (rightTensorIdeal_mono (R := R) (H := H)
      (le_iSup (fun I : S => (I : HopfIdeal R H).toIdeal) I))
    ((I : HopfIdeal R H).comul_mem (hf I))

name: counit_eq_zero_sSup
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  rw [Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun I _ => (I : HopfIdeal R H).counit_eq_zero (hf I)

name: antipode_mem_sSup
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  rw [Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun I _ =>
    Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem I ((I : HopfIdeal R H).antipode_mem (hf I))

name: sSup_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sSup_toIdeal (S : Set (HopfIdeal R H)) :
    (sSup S).toIdeal = ⨆ I : S, (I : HopfIdeal R H).toIdeal

name: mem_sSup
statement:
theorem mem_sSup {S : Set (HopfIdeal R H)} {x : H} :
    x ∈ sSup S ↔
      ∃ f : S →₀ H, (∀ I : S, f I ∈ (I : HopfIdeal R H)) ∧ f.sum (fun _ y => y) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toIdeal, sSup_toIdeal]
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp (fun I : S => (I : HopfIdeal R H).toIdeal) x

name: iSup_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iSup_toIdeal {ι : Sort*} (I : ι → HopfIdeal R H) :
    (⨆ i, I i).toIdeal = ⨆ i, (I i).toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSup, sSup_toIdeal]
  ext x
  simp [Submodule.mem_iSup]

name: mem_iSup
statement:
theorem mem_iSup {ι : Type*} {I : ι → HopfIdeal R H} {x : H} :
    x ∈ ⨆ i, I i ↔ ∃ f : ι →₀ H, (∀ i, f i ∈ I i) ∧ f.sum (fun _ y => y) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toIdeal, iSup_toIdeal]
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp (fun i => (I i).toIdeal) x

name: comul_mem_tensor_map_ker
statement:
private theorem comul_mem_tensor_map_ker (f : H →ₐc[R] K) {x : H}
    (hx : x ∈ RingHom.ker (f : H →ₐ[R] K)) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) x ∈
      RingHom.ker
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (f : H →ₐ[R] K) (f : H →ₐ[R] K)).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
  calc
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (f : H →ₐ[R] K) (f : H →ₐ[R] K) (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) x)
        = Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (f x) := CoalgHomClass.map_comp_comul_apply f x
    _ = 0 := by
      have hfx : f x = 0 := RingHom.mem_ker.mp hx
      simpa using congrArg (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := K)) hfx

name: tensor_map_ker_eq_left_sup_right
statement:
private theorem tensor_map_ker_eq_left_sup_right (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (f : H →ₐ[R] K) (f : H →ₐ[R] K)) =
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (RingHom.ker (f : H →ₐ[R] K)) ⊔
        rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (RingHom.ker (f : H →ₐ[R] K))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_ker (f := (f : H →ₐ[R] K)) (g := (f : H →ₐ[R] K)) hf hf,
    leftTensorIdeal_def, rightTensorIdeal_def]
  simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe]
  
  
  
  apply congr_arg₂ (· ⊔ ·) <;> rfl

name: ker_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_toIdeal (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (ker f hf).toIdeal = RingHom.ker (f : H →ₐ[R] K)

name: mem_ker
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_ker (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) {x : H} :
    x ∈ ker f hf ↔ f x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toIdeal, ker_toIdeal, RingHom.mem_ker]
  rfl

name: ker_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem ker_eq_bot_iff (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    ker f hf = ⊥ ↔ Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x y hxy
    have hmem : x - y ∈ ker f hf := by
      rw [mem_ker, map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
    have hzero : x - y = 0 := by
      rw [h] at hmem
      exact (HopfIdeal.mem_bot (R := R) (H := H)).mp hmem
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero
  · intro hinj
    ext x
    rw [mem_ker, mem_bot]
    exact ⟨fun hx => hinj (by simpa using hx), fun hx => by rw [hx, map_zero]⟩

name: kerLiftBialgHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerLiftBialgHom_mk (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (h : H) :
    kerLiftBialgHom f hf (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (ker f hf).toIdeal h) = f h
proof:
:=
  liftBialgHom_mk (ker f hf) f (by
    intro x hx
    simpa [ker_toIdeal] using hx) h

name: kerLiftBialgHom_comp_mkBialgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerLiftBialgHom_comp_mkBialgHom (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (kerLiftBialgHom f hf).comp (mkBialgHom (ker f hf)) = f
proof:
:=
  liftBialgHom_comp_mkBialgHom (ker f hf) f (by
    intro x hx
    simpa [ker_toIdeal] using hx)

name: kerLiftBialgHom_bijective
statement:
private theorem kerLiftBialgHom_bijective (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Bijective (kerLiftBialgHom f hf)
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (kerLiftBialgHom f hf : H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal → K) =
      (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (f := (f : H →ₐ[R] K)) hf :
        H ⧸ RingHom.ker (f : H →ₐ[R] K) → K) := by
    ext q
    obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_surjective R (ker f hf).toIdeal q
    rw [kerLiftBialgHom_mk, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk]
    exact (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_mk (f := (f : H →ₐ[R] K)) hf h).symm
  rw [hfun]
  exact (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (f := (f : H →ₐ[R] K)) hf).bijective

name: kerLiftBialgEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerLiftBialgEquiv_apply (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (q : H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal) :
    kerLiftBialgEquiv f hf q = kerLiftBialgHom f hf q

name: kerLiftBialgEquiv_toBialgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerLiftBialgEquiv_toBialgHom (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (kerLiftBialgEquiv f hf : H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal →ₐc[R] K) = kerLiftBialgHom f hf

name: ker_mkBialgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_mkBialgHom (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    ker (mkBialgHom I) (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_surjective R I.toIdeal) = I
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_ker, mkBialgHom_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, mem_toIdeal]

name: includeLeft_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem includeLeft_apply (x : H₁) : includeLeft (H₂ := H₂) x = x ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : H₂)

name: includeRight_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem includeRight_apply (y : H₂) : includeRight (H₁ := H₁) y = (1 : H₁) ⊗ₜ[R] y

name: includeLeft_toAlgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem includeLeft_toAlgHom :
    (includeLeft : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₁ ⊗[R] H₂).toAlgHom = Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [BialgHom.coe_toAlgHom, includeLeft_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply]

name: includeRight_toAlgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem includeRight_toAlgHom :
    (includeRight : H₂ →ₐc[R] H₁ ⊗[R] H₂).toAlgHom = Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp only [BialgHom.coe_toAlgHom, includeRight_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply]

name: tensor_range_mono
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨TensorProduct.map (Submodule.inclusion hPQ) (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C) x, ?_⟩
  induction x with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul p c => rfl
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]

name: coact_mem_sup
statement:
private lemma coact_mem_sup (N P : Subcomodule R C M) {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ N.toSubmodule ⊔ P.toSubmodule) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m ∈
      LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.map (N.toSubmodule ⊔ P.toSubmodule).subtype
          (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))
proof:
:= by
  rcases Submodule.mem_sup.1 hm with ⟨n, hn, p, hp, rfl⟩
  rw [LinearMap.map_add]
  exact add_mem
    (tensor_range_mono
      (P := N.toSubmodule) (Q := N.toSubmodule ⊔ P.toSubmodule) le_sup_left
      (N.coact_mem hn))
    (tensor_range_mono
      (P := P.toSubmodule) (Q := N.toSubmodule ⊔ P.toSubmodule) le_sup_right
      (P.coact_mem hp))

name: coact_mem_sSup
statement:
private lemma coact_mem_sSup (S : Set (Subcomodule R C M)) {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ ⨆ N : S, (N : Subcomodule R C M).toSubmodule) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m ∈
      LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.map (⨆ N : S, (N : Subcomodule R C M).toSubmodule).subtype
          (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp] at hm
  rcases hm with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  rw [Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun N _ =>
    tensor_range_mono
      (P := (N : Subcomodule R C M).toSubmodule)
      (Q := ⨆ N : S, (N : Subcomodule R C M).toSubmodule)
      (le_iSup (fun N : S => (N : Subcomodule R C M).toSubmodule) N)
      (N.1.coact_mem (hf N))

name: sup_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_toSubmodule (N P : Subcomodule R C M) :
    (N ⊔ P).toSubmodule = N.toSubmodule ⊔ P.toSubmodule

name: mem_sup
statement:
theorem mem_sup {N P : Subcomodule R C M} {m : M} :
    m ∈ N ⊔ P ↔ ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p ∈ P, n + p = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, sup_toSubmodule, Submodule.mem_sup]
  rfl

name: le_sup_left'
statement: private theorem le_sup_left' (N P : Subcomodule R C M) : N ≤ N ⊔ P
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, sup_toSubmodule]
  exact Submodule.mem_sup_left ((mem_toSubmodule).2 hm)

name: le_sup_right'
statement: private theorem le_sup_right' (N P : Subcomodule R C M) : P ≤ N ⊔ P
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, sup_toSubmodule]
  exact Submodule.mem_sup_right ((mem_toSubmodule).2 hm)

name: sup_le'
statement:
private theorem sup_le' {N P Q : Subcomodule R C M} (hN : N ≤ Q) (hP : P ≤ Q) :
    N ⊔ P ≤ Q
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  rw [mem_sup] at hm
  rcases hm with ⟨n, hn, p, hp, rfl⟩
  exact add_mem (hN hn) (hP hp)

name: sSup_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sSup_toSubmodule (S : Set (Subcomodule R C M)) :
    (sSup S).toSubmodule = ⨆ N : S, (N : Subcomodule R C M).toSubmodule

name: mem_sSup
statement:
theorem mem_sSup {S : Set (Subcomodule R C M)} {m : M} :
    m ∈ sSup S ↔
      ∃ f : S →₀ M, (∀ N : S, f N ∈ (N : Subcomodule R C M)) ∧
        f.sum (fun _ x => x) = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, sSup_toSubmodule]
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp
    (fun N : S => (N : Subcomodule R C M).toSubmodule) m

name: iSup_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iSup_toSubmodule {ι : Sort*} (N : ι → Subcomodule R C M) :
    (⨆ i, N i).toSubmodule = ⨆ i, (N i).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSup, sSup_toSubmodule]
  ext m
  simp [Submodule.mem_iSup]

name: mem_iSup
statement:
theorem mem_iSup {ι : Type*} {N : ι → Subcomodule R C M} {m : M} :
    m ∈ ⨆ i, N i ↔
      ∃ f : ι →₀ M, (∀ i, f i ∈ N i) ∧ f.sum (fun _ x => x) = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, iSup_toSubmodule]
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp (fun i => (N i).toSubmodule) m

name: sup_finite
statement:
theorem sup_finite (N P : Subcomodule R C M)
    [Module.Finite R N.toSubmodule] [Module.Finite R P.toSubmodule] :
    Module.Finite R (N ⊔ P).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup_toSubmodule, Module.Finite.iff_fg]
  exact (Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp inferInstance).sup (Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp inferInstance)

name: finset_sup_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finset_sup_toSubmodule (s : Finset ι) (N : ι → Subcomodule R C M) :
    (s.sup N).toSubmodule = s.sup fun i => (N i).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact bot_toSubmodule
  | insert a s _ ih =>
      rw [Finset.sup_insert, sup_toSubmodule, ih, Finset.sup_insert]

name: mem_finset_sup
statement:
theorem mem_finset_sup {s : Finset ι} {N : ι → Subcomodule R C M} {m : M} :
    m ∈ s.sup N ↔ ∃ μ : ∀ i, (N i).toSubmodule, (∑ i ∈ s, (μ i : M)) = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, finset_sup_toSubmodule]
  simpa only [Finset.sup_eq_iSup] using
    (Submodule.mem_iSup_finset_iff_exists_sum (fun i => (N i).toSubmodule) m)

name: iSup_finite
statement:
theorem iSup_finite {ι : Sort*} [Finite ι] (N : ι → Subcomodule R C M)
    (hN : ∀ i, Module.Finite R (N i).toSubmodule) :
    Module.Finite R (⨆ i, N i).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSup_toSubmodule, Module.Finite.iff_fg]
  exact Submodule.fg_iSup (fun i => (N i).toSubmodule)
    fun i => Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp (hN i)

name: finset_sup_finite
statement:
theorem finset_sup_finite (s : Finset ι) (N : ι → Subcomodule R C M)
    (hN : ∀ i ∈ s, Module.Finite R (N i).toSubmodule) :
    Module.Finite R (s.sup N).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finset_sup_toSubmodule, Module.Finite.iff_fg]
  exact Submodule.fg_finset_sup s (fun i => (N i).toSubmodule)
    fun i hi => Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp (hN i hi)

name: map_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_sup (f : Comodule.Hom R C M M') (N P : Subcomodule R C M) :
    (N ⊔ P).map f = N.map f ⊔ P.map f
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, map_toSubmodule, sup_toSubmodule, Submodule.map_sup,
    ← map_toSubmodule N f, ← map_toSubmodule P f, ← sup_toSubmodule, mem_toSubmodule]

name: map_iSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_iSup {ι : Sort*} (f : Comodule.Hom R C M M') (N : ι → Subcomodule R C M) :
    (⨆ i, N i).map f = ⨆ i, (N i).map f
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, map_toSubmodule, iSup_toSubmodule, Submodule.map_iSup]
  simp_rw [← map_toSubmodule (f := f)]
  rw [← iSup_toSubmodule, mem_toSubmodule]

name: map_finset_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_finset_sup (s : Finset ι) (f : Comodule.Hom R C M M')
    (N : ι → Subcomodule R C M) :
    (s.sup N).map f = s.sup fun i => (N i).map f
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => rw [Finset.sup_empty, Finset.sup_empty, map_bot]
  | cons i s hi ih => rw [Finset.sup_cons, Finset.sup_cons, map_sup, ih]

name: groupLikeSetSpan_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupLikeSetSpan_toSubmodule (s : Set (GroupLike R C)) :
    (groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := C) s).toSubmodule =
      Submodule.span R ((↑) '' s : Set C)

name: mem_groupLikeSetSpan
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_groupLikeSetSpan {s : Set (GroupLike R C)} {c : C} :
    c ∈ groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := C) s ↔
      c ∈ Submodule.span R ((↑) '' s : Set C)

name: groupLike_mem_groupLikeSetSpan
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_groupLikeSetSpan]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩

name: groupLikeSetSpan_le
statement:
theorem groupLikeSetSpan_le {s : Set (GroupLike R C)} {D : Subcoalgebra R C} :
    groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := C) s ≤ D ↔ ∀ g ∈ s, (g : C) ∈ D
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h g hg
    exact h (groupLike_mem_groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := C) hg)
  · intro h c hc
    rw [mem_groupLikeSetSpan] at hc
    rw [← mem_toSubmodule]
    have hspan : ((↑) '' s : Set C) ⊆ D.toSubmodule := by
      rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
      exact (mem_toSubmodule).2 (h g hg)
    exact (Submodule.span_le.2 hspan) hc

name: groupLikeSetSpan_mono
statement:
theorem groupLikeSetSpan_mono {s t : Set (GroupLike R C)} (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := C) s ≤ groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := C) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [groupLikeSetSpan_le]
  intro g hg
  exact groupLike_mem_groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := C) (hst hg)

name: groupLikeSpan_le
statement:
theorem groupLikeSpan_le {g : GroupLike R C} {D : Subcoalgebra R C} :
    groupLikeSpan (R := R) (C := C) g ≤ D ↔ (g : C) ∈ D

name: groupLikeSpan_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupLikeSpan_toSubmodule (g : GroupLike R C) :
    (groupLikeSpan (R := R) (C := C) g).toSubmodule = R ∙ (g : C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [groupLikeSpan, groupLikeSetSpan_toSubmodule]
  congr 1
  ext c
  simp

name: groupLike_mem_groupLikeSpan
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupLike_mem_groupLikeSpan (g : GroupLike R C) :
    (g : C) ∈ groupLikeSpan (R := R) (C := C) g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, groupLikeSpan_toSubmodule]
  exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self (g : C)

name: mem_groupLikeSpan
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_groupLikeSpan {g : GroupLike R C} {c : C} :
    c ∈ groupLikeSpan (R := R) (C := C) g ↔ ∃ r : R, r • (g : C) = c

name: groupLikeSetSpan_finite
statement:
theorem groupLikeSetSpan_finite (s : Set (GroupLike R C)) (hs : s.Finite) :
    Module.Finite R (groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := C) s).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [groupLikeSetSpan_toSubmodule]
  exact Module.Finite.span_of_finite R (hs.image ((↑) : GroupLike R C → C))

name: image_tensorSquare_apply
statement:
private theorem image_tensorSquare_apply (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (A : Subcoalgebra R C)
    (t : A.carrier ⊗[R] A.carrier) :
    TensorProduct.map (A.carrier.map f.toLinearMap).subtype
        (A.carrier.map f.toLinearMap).subtype
        (TensorProduct.map (mapSubtype f A) (mapSubtype f A) t) =
      TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap f.toLinearMap
        (TensorProduct.map A.carrier.subtype A.carrier.subtype t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | tmul a b => rfl
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: map_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_toSubmodule (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (A : Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (A.map f).toSubmodule = A.toSubmodule.map f.toLinearMap

name: mem_map
statement:
theorem mem_map {f : C →ₗc[R] D} {A : Subcoalgebra R C} {d : D} :
    d ∈ A.map f ↔ ∃ c ∈ A, f c = d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, map_toSubmodule, Submodule.mem_map]
  rfl

name: mem_map_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_map_of_mem (f : C →ₗc[R] D) {A : Subcoalgebra R C} {c : C} (hc : c ∈ A) :
    f c ∈ A.map f

name: map_le_iff
statement:
theorem map_le_iff {f : C →ₗc[R] D} {A : Subcoalgebra R C} {B : Subcoalgebra R D} :
    A.map f ≤ B ↔ ∀ ⦃c⦄, c ∈ A → f c ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h c hc
    exact h (mem_map_of_mem f hc)
  · intro h d hd
    rcases (mem_map (f := f) (A := A)).1 hd with ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    exact h hc

name: map_mono
statement:
theorem map_mono (f : C →ₗc[R] D) {A B : Subcoalgebra R C} (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    A.map f ≤ B.map f
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  rcases (mem_map (f := f) (A := A)).1 hd with ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
  exact mem_map_of_mem f (hAB hc)

name: map_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_bot (f : C →ₗc[R] D) : (⊥ : Subcoalgebra R C).map f = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  rw [mem_map, mem_bot]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_bot] at hc
    rw [hc, map_zero]
  · intro hd
    exact ⟨0, by rw [mem_bot], by rw [hd, map_zero]⟩

name: map_top_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_top_toSubmodule (f : C →ₗc[R] D) :
    ((⊤ : Subcoalgebra R C).map f).toSubmodule = LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id (A : Subcoalgebra R C) : A.map (CoalgHom.id R C) = A
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  rw [mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c', hc', h⟩
    exact h ▸ hc'
  · intro hc
    exact ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩

name: map_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_map (A : Subcoalgebra R C) (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : D →ₗc[R] E) :
    (A.map f).map g = A.map (g.comp f)
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  constructor
  · rw [mem_map, mem_map]
    rintro ⟨d, ⟨c, hc, hcd⟩, hde⟩
    refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
    calc
      (g.comp f) c = g (f c) := by simp only [CoalgHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
      _ = g d := congrArg g hcd
      _ = e := hde
  · rw [mem_map]
    rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    exact mem_map_of_mem g (mem_map_of_mem f hc)

name: map_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_sup (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (A B : Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (A ⊔ B).map f = A.map f ⊔ B.map f
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, map_toSubmodule, sup_toSubmodule, Submodule.map_sup,
    ← map_toSubmodule f A, ← map_toSubmodule f B, ← sup_toSubmodule, mem_toSubmodule]

name: map_iSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_iSup {ι : Sort*} (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (A : ι → Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (⨆ i, A i).map f = ⨆ i, (A i).map f
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, map_toSubmodule, iSup_toSubmodule, Submodule.map_iSup]
  simp_rw [← map_toSubmodule f]
  rw [← iSup_toSubmodule, mem_toSubmodule]

name: map_finset_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_finset_sup {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : C →ₗc[R] D)
    (A : ι → Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (s.sup A).map f = s.sup fun i => (A i).map f
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => rw [Finset.sup_empty, Finset.sup_empty, map_bot]
  | cons i s hi ih => rw [Finset.sup_cons, Finset.sup_cons, map_sup, ih]

name: map_finite
statement:
theorem map_finite (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (A : Subcoalgebra R C)
    [Module.Finite R A.toSubmodule] : Module.Finite R (A.map f).toSubmodule

name: tensorSquare_range_mono
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨TensorProduct.map (Submodule.inclusion hPQ) (Submodule.inclusion hPQ) x, ?_⟩
  induction x with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul p q => rfl
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]

name: comul_mem_sup
statement:
private lemma comul_mem_sup (D E : Subcoalgebra R C) {c : C}
    (hc : c ∈ D.toSubmodule ⊔ E.toSubmodule) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C) c ∈
      LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.map (D.toSubmodule ⊔ E.toSubmodule).subtype
          (D.toSubmodule ⊔ E.toSubmodule).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Submodule.mem_sup.1 hc with ⟨d, hd, e, he, rfl⟩
  rw [LinearMap.map_add]
  exact add_mem
    (tensorSquare_range_mono
      (P := D.toSubmodule) (Q := D.toSubmodule ⊔ E.toSubmodule) le_sup_left
      (D.comul_mem hd))
    (tensorSquare_range_mono
      (P := E.toSubmodule) (Q := D.toSubmodule ⊔ E.toSubmodule) le_sup_right
      (E.comul_mem he))

name: comul_mem_sSup
statement:
private lemma comul_mem_sSup (S : Set (Subcoalgebra R C)) {c : C}
    (hc : c ∈ ⨆ D : S, (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toSubmodule) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C) c ∈
      LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.map (⨆ D : S, (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toSubmodule).subtype
          (⨆ D : S, (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toSubmodule).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp] at hc
  rcases hc with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  rw [Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun D _ =>
    tensorSquare_range_mono
      (P := (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toSubmodule)
      (Q := ⨆ D : S, (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toSubmodule)
      (le_iSup (fun D : S => (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toSubmodule) D)
      (D.1.comul_mem (hf D))

name: sup_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_toSubmodule (D E : Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (D ⊔ E).toSubmodule = D.toSubmodule ⊔ E.toSubmodule

name: mem_sup
statement:
theorem mem_sup {D E : Subcoalgebra R C} {c : C} :
    c ∈ D ⊔ E ↔ ∃ d ∈ D, ∃ e ∈ E, d + e = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, sup_toSubmodule, Submodule.mem_sup]
  rfl

name: le_sup_left'
statement: private theorem le_sup_left' (D E : Subcoalgebra R C) : D ≤ D ⊔ E
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, sup_toSubmodule]
  exact Submodule.mem_sup_left ((mem_toSubmodule).2 hc)

name: le_sup_right'
statement: private theorem le_sup_right' (D E : Subcoalgebra R C) : E ≤ D ⊔ E
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, sup_toSubmodule]
  exact Submodule.mem_sup_right ((mem_toSubmodule).2 hc)

name: sup_le'
statement:
private theorem sup_le' {D E F : Subcoalgebra R C} (hD : D ≤ F) (hE : E ≤ F) :
    D ⊔ E ≤ F
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc
  rw [mem_sup] at hc
  rcases hc with ⟨d, hd, e, he, rfl⟩
  exact add_mem (hD hd) (hE he)

name: sSup_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sSup_toSubmodule (S : Set (Subcoalgebra R C)) :
    (sSup S).toSubmodule = ⨆ D : S, (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toSubmodule

name: mem_sSup
statement:
theorem mem_sSup {S : Set (Subcoalgebra R C)} {c : C} :
    c ∈ sSup S ↔
      ∃ f : S →₀ C, (∀ D : S, f D ∈ (D : Subcoalgebra R C)) ∧
        f.sum (fun _ x => x) = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, sSup_toSubmodule]
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp
    (fun D : S => (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toSubmodule) c

name: iSup_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iSup_toSubmodule {ι : Sort*} (D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (⨆ i, D i).toSubmodule = ⨆ i, (D i).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSup, sSup_toSubmodule]
  ext c
  simp [Submodule.mem_iSup]

name: mem_iSup
statement:
theorem mem_iSup {ι : Type*} {D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C} {c : C} :
    c ∈ ⨆ i, D i ↔
      ∃ f : ι →₀ C, (∀ i, f i ∈ D i) ∧ f.sum (fun _ x => x) = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, iSup_toSubmodule]
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp (fun i => (D i).toSubmodule) c

name: sup_finite
statement:
theorem sup_finite (D E : Subcoalgebra R C)
    [Module.Finite R D.toSubmodule] [Module.Finite R E.toSubmodule] :
    Module.Finite R (D ⊔ E).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup_toSubmodule, Module.Finite.iff_fg]
  exact (Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp inferInstance).sup (Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp inferInstance)

name: finset_sup_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finset_sup_toSubmodule (s : Finset ι) (D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (s.sup D).toSubmodule = s.sup fun i => (D i).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact bot_toSubmodule
  | insert a s _ ih =>
      rw [Finset.sup_insert, sup_toSubmodule, ih, Finset.sup_insert]

name: mem_finset_sup
statement:
theorem mem_finset_sup {s : Finset ι} {D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C} {c : C} :
    c ∈ s.sup D ↔ ∃ μ : ∀ i, (D i).toSubmodule, (∑ i ∈ s, (μ i : C)) = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toSubmodule, finset_sup_toSubmodule]
  simpa only [Finset.sup_eq_iSup] using
    (Submodule.mem_iSup_finset_iff_exists_sum (fun i => (D i).toSubmodule) c)

name: iSup_finite
statement:
theorem iSup_finite [Finite ι] (D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C)
    (hD : ∀ i, Module.Finite R (D i).toSubmodule) :
    Module.Finite R (⨆ i, D i).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  rw [iSup_toSubmodule, Module.Finite.iff_fg]
  simpa [Finset.sup_eq_iSup] using
    Submodule.fg_finset_sup Finset.univ (fun i => (D i).toSubmodule)
      fun i _ => Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp (hD i)

name: finset_sup_finite
statement:
theorem finset_sup_finite (s : Finset ι) (D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C)
    (hD : ∀ i ∈ s, Module.Finite R (D i).toSubmodule) :
    Module.Finite R (s.sup D).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finset_sup_toSubmodule, Module.Finite.iff_fg]
  exact Submodule.fg_finset_sup s (fun i => (D i).toSubmodule)
    fun i hi => Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp (hD i hi)

name: tensorSquare_range_le_regular_range
statement:
private theorem tensorSquare_range_le_regular_range (D : Subcoalgebra R C) :
    LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map D.toSubmodule.subtype D.toSubmodule.subtype) ≤
      LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.map D.toSubmodule.subtype (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : D.toSubmodule →ₗ[R] D.toSubmodule)
      D.toSubmodule.subtype t, ?_⟩
  induction t with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | tmul d e => rfl
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: toRegularSubcomodule_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_toSubmodule (D : Subcoalgebra R C) :

name: mem_toRegularSubcomodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_toRegularSubcomodule {D : Subcoalgebra R C} {c : C} :
    c ∈ D.toRegularSubcomodule ↔ c ∈ D

name: toRegularSubcomodule_mono
statement:
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_mono {D E : Subcoalgebra R C} (hDE : D ≤ E) :
    D.toRegularSubcomodule ≤ E.toRegularSubcomodule
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc
  exact mem_toRegularSubcomodule.2 (hDE (mem_toRegularSubcomodule.1 hc))

name: toRegularSubcomoduleOrderEmbedding_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toRegularSubcomoduleOrderEmbedding_apply (D : Subcoalgebra R C) :
    toRegularSubcomoduleOrderEmbedding (R := R) (C := C) D = D.toRegularSubcomodule

name: toRegularSubcomodule_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_bot :
    (⊥ : Subcoalgebra R C).toRegularSubcomodule = (⊥ : Subcomodule R C C)

name: toRegularSubcomodule_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_top :
    (⊤ : Subcoalgebra R C).toRegularSubcomodule = (⊤ : Subcomodule R C C)

name: toRegularSubcomodule_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_sup (D E : Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (D ⊔ E).toRegularSubcomodule = D.toRegularSubcomodule ⊔ E.toRegularSubcomodule
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  rw [mem_toRegularSubcomodule, Subcomodule.mem_sup, mem_sup]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d, hd, e, he, hde⟩
    exact ⟨d, hd, e, he, hde⟩
  · rintro ⟨d, hd, e, he, hde⟩
    exact ⟨d, hd, e, he, hde⟩

name: toRegularSubcomodule_iSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_iSup {ι : Sort*} (D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (⨆ i, D i).toRegularSubcomodule = ⨆ i, (D i).toRegularSubcomodule
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  rw [← Subcomodule.mem_toSubmodule
      (N := (⨆ i, D i).toRegularSubcomodule),
    ← Subcomodule.mem_toSubmodule
      (N := ⨆ i, (D i).toRegularSubcomodule)]
  rw [Subcomodule.iSup_toSubmodule, toRegularSubcomodule_toSubmodule, iSup_toSubmodule]
  simp_rw [toRegularSubcomodule_toSubmodule]

name: toRegularSubcomodule_sSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_sSup (S : Set (Subcoalgebra R C)) :
    (sSup S).toRegularSubcomodule =
      ⨆ D : S, (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toRegularSubcomodule
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  rw [← Subcomodule.mem_toSubmodule
      (N := (sSup S).toRegularSubcomodule),
    ← Subcomodule.mem_toSubmodule
      (N := ⨆ D : S, (D : Subcoalgebra R C).toRegularSubcomodule)]
  rw [Subcomodule.iSup_toSubmodule, toRegularSubcomodule_toSubmodule, sSup_toSubmodule]
  simp_rw [toRegularSubcomodule_toSubmodule]

name: toRegularSubcomodule_finset_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_finset_sup {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (D : ι → Subcoalgebra R C) :
    (s.sup D).toRegularSubcomodule = s.sup fun i => (D i).toRegularSubcomodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s hi ih => simp [ih]

name: toRegularSubcomodule_finite
statement:
theorem toRegularSubcomodule_finite (D : Subcoalgebra R C)

theorem forget₂_semimoduleCat_obj (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :

name: of_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem of_obj (M : Type w) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [Module.Finite R M] :
    (of (R := R) (C := C) M).obj = ComoduleCat.of R C M

name: of_coact

theorem of_coact {M : Type w} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [Module.Finite R M] :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := of (R := R) (C := C) M) =

name: ofHom_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_hom {M N : Type w} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [Module.Finite R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Comodule R C N]

name: ofHom_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_id {M : Type w} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [Module.Finite R M] :
    ofHom (R := R) (C := C) (Comodule.Hom.id R C M) = 𝟙 (of (R := R) (C := C) M)

name: ofHom_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_comp {M N P : Type w} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [Module.Finite R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Comodule R C N]
    [Module.Finite R N] [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] [Comodule R C P]
    [Module.Finite R P] (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) (g : Comodule.Hom R C N P) :
    ofHom (R := R) (C := C) (Comodule.Hom.comp g f) =
      ofHom (R := R) (C := C) f ≫ ofHom (R := R) (C := C) g

name: ofHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_apply {M N : Type w} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [Module.Finite R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Comodule R C N]
    [Module.Finite R N] (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) (m : M) :
    ofHom (R := R) (C := C) f m = f m

name: zero_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_obj :
    (zero R C : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C).obj = ComoduleCat.zero R C

name: isZero_zero
statement: theorem isZero_zero : IsZero (zero R C : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C)
proof:
:=
  IsZero.of_full_of_faithful_of_isZero (ComoduleCat.isFG (R := R) (C := C)).ι (zero R C)
    (ComoduleCat.isZero_zero R C)

name: zero_hom_eq_zero
statement: theorem zero_hom_eq_zero (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (f : zero R C ⟶ M) : f = 0

name: hom_zero_eq_zero
statement: theorem hom_zero_eq_zero (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (f : M ⟶ zero R C) : f = 0

name: isZero_zero_to

@[simp]
theorem isZero_zero_to (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (isZero_zero (R := R) (C := C)).to_ M = 0

name: isZero_zero_from

@[simp]
theorem isZero_zero_from (M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :

@[ext]
theorem zero_hom_ext {M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f g : zero R C ⟶ M) : f = g
