@[ext]
theorem hom_zero_ext {M : FGComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f g : M ⟶ zero R C) : f = g

name: transportCoact_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportCoact_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (n : N) :
    transportCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e n =
      TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id
        (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (e.symm n))

name: transportCoact_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportCoact_refl :
    transportCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := M) (LinearEquiv.refl R M) =
      coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)

name: assoc_rTensor_transportCoact
statement:
private theorem assoc_rTensor_transportCoact (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (t : M ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.assoc R N C C
        ((transportCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e).rTensor C
          (TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id t)) =
      TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id LinearMap.id)
        (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C
          ((coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).rTensor C t))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    TensorProduct.assoc R N C C
        ((transportCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e).rTensor C
          (TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id t))
      = TensorProduct.assoc R N C C
          (TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id) LinearMap.id
            ((coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).rTensor C t)) := by
          induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
          | zero => simp [transportCoact, LinearMap.rTensor]
          | tmul m c => simp [transportCoact, LinearMap.rTensor]
          | add x y hx hy => simpa using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy
    _ = TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id LinearMap.id)
          (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C
            ((coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).rTensor C t)) := by
          exact (TensorProduct.map_map_assoc e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id LinearMap.id
            ((coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).rTensor C t)).symm

name: comul_lTensor_transport_map
statement:
private theorem comul_lTensor_transport_map (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (t : M ⊗[R] C) :
    Coalgebra.comul.lTensor N (TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id t) =
      TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id LinearMap.id)
        (Coalgebra.comul.lTensor M t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul m c => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]

name: counit_lTensor_transport_map
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul m c => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]

name: transport_coact
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transport_coact (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N
proof:
:= Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e
    coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) =
      transportCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e :=
  rfl

name: transport_coact_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transport_coact_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (n : N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N
proof:
:= Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e
    coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) n =
      TensorProduct.map e.toLinearMap LinearMap.id
        (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (e.symm n)) :=
  rfl

name: transportCoact_trans
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportCoact_trans (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (f : N ≃ₗ[R] P) :
    transportCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := P) (e.trans f) =
      letI : Comodule R C N
proof:
:= Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e
      transportCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) (N := P) f :=
  by
    ext p
    dsimp [transportCoact]
    rw [TensorProduct.map_map]
    congr

name: tensor_map_transport_conj
statement:
private theorem tensor_map_transport_conj (eM : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (eN : M' ≃ₗ[R] N')
    (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (t : M ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.map (eN.toLinearMap.comp (f.comp eM.symm.toLinearMap)) LinearMap.id
        (TensorProduct.map eM.toLinearMap LinearMap.id t) =
      TensorProduct.map eN.toLinearMap LinearMap.id (TensorProduct.map f LinearMap.id t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TensorProduct.map_map, TensorProduct.map_map]
  congr
  ext m
  simp

name: transportHom_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportHom_toLinearMap (eM : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (eN : M' ≃ₗ[R] N') (f : Hom R C M M') :
    letI : Comodule R C N
proof:
:= Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) eM
    letI : Comodule R C N' := Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M') (N := N') eN
    (transportHom (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (M' := M') (N := N) (N' := N') eM eN f).toLinearMap =
      eN.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ eM.symm.toLinearMap :=
  rfl

name: transportHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportHom_apply (eM : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (eN : M' ≃ₗ[R] N') (f : Hom R C M M')
    (n : N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N
proof:
:= Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) eM
    letI : Comodule R C N' := Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M') (N := N') eN
    transportHom (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (M' := M') (N := N) (N' := N') eM eN f n =
      eN (f (eM.symm n)) :=
  rfl

name: transportHom_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportHom_id (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N
proof:
:= Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e
    transportHom (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (M' := M) (N := N) (N' := N) e e
        (Comodule.Hom.id R C M) =
      Comodule.Hom.id R C N :=
  by
    letI : Comodule R C N := Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e
    ext n
    rw [transportHom_apply, Comodule.Hom.id_apply, Comodule.Hom.id_apply]
    exact e.apply_symm_apply n

name: transportHom_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportHom_comp (eM : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (eM' : M' ≃ₗ[R] N') (eP : P ≃ₗ[R] P')
    (f : Hom R C M M') (g : Hom R C M' P) :
    letI : Comodule R C N
proof:
:= Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) eM
    letI : Comodule R C N' := Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M') (N := N') eM'
    letI : Comodule R C P' := Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := P) (N := P') eP
    transportHom (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (M' := P) (N := N) (N' := P') eM eP
        (Comodule.Hom.comp g f) =
      Comodule.Hom.comp
        (transportHom (R := R) (C := C) (M := M') (M' := P) (N := N') (N' := P')
          eM' eP g)
        (transportHom (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (M' := M') (N := N) (N' := N')
          eM eM' f) :=
  by
    letI : Comodule R C N := Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) eM
    letI : Comodule R C N' := Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M') (N := N') eM'
    letI : Comodule R C P' := Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := P) (N := P') eP
    ext n
    simp [transportHom_apply, Comodule.Hom.comp_apply]

name: transportToHom_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportToHom_toLinearMap (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N
proof:
:= Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e
    (transportToHom (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e).toLinearMap =
      e.toLinearMap := by
  rfl

name: transportInvHom_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportInvHom_toLinearMap (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N
proof:
:= Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e
    (transportInvHom (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e).toLinearMap =
      e.symm.toLinearMap := by
  rfl

name: transportToHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportToHom_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (m : M) :
    letI : Comodule R C N
proof:
:= Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e
    transportToHom (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e m = e m := by
  rfl

name: transportInvHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportInvHom_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (n : N) :
    letI : Comodule R C N
proof:
:= Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e
    transportInvHom (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e n = e.symm n := by
  rfl

name: transport_coact
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transport_coact (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := transport R C e) =
      Comodule.transportCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) e

name: transportIso_hom_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportIso_hom_toLinearMap (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N₀) :
    ((transportIso (R := R) (C := C) e).hom).toLinearMap = e.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  Comodule.transportToHom_toLinearMap (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N₀) e

name: transportIso_inv_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportIso_inv_toLinearMap (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N₀) :
    ((transportIso (R := R) (C := C) e).inv).toLinearMap = e.symm.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  Comodule.transportInvHom_toLinearMap (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N₀) e

name: transportIso_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportIso_hom_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N₀) (m : M) :
    (transportIso (R := R) (C := C) e).hom m = e m

name: transportIso_inv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportIso_inv_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N₀) (n : N₀) :
    (transportIso (R := R) (C := C) e).inv n = e.symm n

name: matrixCoefficientSet_transport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficientSet_transport (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N₀) :
    letI : Comodule R C N₀
proof:
:= Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N₀) e
    matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := N₀) =
      matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) := by
  letI : Comodule R C N₀ := Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N₀) e
  exact (matrixCoefficientSet_eq_of_inverse_hom
    (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N₀)
    (transportToHom (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N₀) e)
    (transportInvHom (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N₀) e)
    (fun n => e.apply_symm_apply n) (fun m => e.symm_apply_apply m)).symm

name: matrixCoefficientSubmodule_transport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficientSubmodule_transport (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N₀) :
    letI : Comodule R C N₀
proof:
:= Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N₀) e
    matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := N₀) =
      matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) := by
  letI : Comodule R C N₀ := Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N₀) e
  rw [matrixCoefficientSubmodule, matrixCoefficientSubmodule, matrixCoefficientSet_transport]

name: matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_transport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficientSubalgebra_transport (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N₀) :
    letI : Comodule R C N₀
proof:
:= Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N₀) e
    matrixCoefficientSubalgebra (R := R) (C := C) (M := N₀) =
      matrixCoefficientSubalgebra (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) := by
  letI : Comodule R C N₀ := Transport (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N₀) e
  rw [matrixCoefficientSubalgebra, matrixCoefficientSubalgebra, matrixCoefficientSet_transport]

name: matrixCoefficientLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficientLinear_apply (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficientLinear (R := R) (C := C) φ m = matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m

name: matrixCoefficient_def
statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_def (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m =
      TensorProduct.lid R C
        (TensorProduct.map φ LinearMap.id (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m))

name: matrixCoefficient_eq_lid_map_coact
statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_eq_lid_map_coact (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m =
      TensorProduct.lid R C
        (TensorProduct.map φ LinearMap.id (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m))

name: matrixCoefficient_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_zero (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ 0 = 0

name: matrixCoefficient_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_add (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m n : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ (m + n) =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m +
        matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ n
proof:
:=
  map_add (matrixCoefficientLinear (R := R) (C := C) φ) m n

name: matrixCoefficient_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_smul (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (r : R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ (r • m) =
      r • matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m
proof:
:=
  map_smul (matrixCoefficientLinear (R := R) (C := C) φ) r m

name: matrixCoefficientBilinear_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficientBilinear_apply (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) :
    matrixCoefficientBilinear (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) φ =
      matrixCoefficientLinear (R := R) (C := C) φ

name: matrixCoefficientBilinear_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficientBilinear_apply_apply (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficientBilinear (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) φ m =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m

name: matrixCoefficient_zero_functional
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_zero_functional (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (0 : M →ₗ[R] R) m = 0

name: matrixCoefficient_add_functional
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_add_functional (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (φ + ψ) m =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m +
        matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) ψ m

name: matrixCoefficient_smul_functional
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_smul_functional (r : R) (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (r • φ) m =
      r • matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m

name: matrixCoefficient_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_map (f : Hom R C M N) (φ : N →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ (f m) =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (φ.comp f.toLinearMap) m
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixCoefficient_eq_lid_map_coact, matrixCoefficient_eq_lid_map_coact,
    ← Hom.map_coact_apply f m]
  exact congrArg (TensorProduct.lid R C)
    (TensorProduct.map_map φ LinearMap.id f.toLinearMap LinearMap.id
      (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m))

name: matrixCoefficient_counit_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_counit_self (c : C) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (M := C) (Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C)) c = c
proof:
:= by
  simpa [matrixCoefficient_eq_lid_map_coact, LinearMap.rTensor] using
    congrArg (TensorProduct.lid R C) (Coalgebra.rTensor_counit_comul (R := R) (A := C) c)

name: matrixCoefficient_groupLike
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_groupLike (g : GroupLike R C) (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    letI : Comodule R C M
proof:
:= groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) g
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m = φ m • (g : C) := by
  letI : Comodule R C M := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) g
  simp [matrixCoefficient_eq_lid_map_coact]

name: matrixCoefficient_trivial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_trivial (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m = φ m • (1 : C)

name: groupLikeToRegular_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupLikeToRegular_toLinearMap (g : GroupLike R C) :
    letI : Comodule R C R
proof:
:= groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := R) g
    (groupLikeToRegular (R := R) (C := C) g).toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R C (g : C) :=
  rfl

name: groupLikeToRegular_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupLikeToRegular_apply (g : GroupLike R C) (r : R) :
    letI : Comodule R C R
proof:
:= groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := R) g
    groupLikeToRegular (R := R) (C := C) g r = r • (g : C) :=
  rfl

name: trivialToRegular_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trivialToRegular_toLinearMap :
    letI : Comodule R C R
proof:
:= trivial (R := R) (C := C) (M := R)
    (trivialToRegular (R := R) (C := C)).toLinearMap = Algebra.linearMap R C := by
  rw [trivialToRegular, groupLikeToRegular_toLinearMap]
  exact LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_one_eq_algebraLinearMap

name: trivialToRegular_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trivialToRegular_apply (r : R) :
    letI : Comodule R C R
proof:
:= trivial (R := R) (C := C) (M := R)
    trivialToRegular (R := R) (C := C) r = algebraMap R C r :=
  by
    letI : Comodule R C R := trivial (R := R) (C := C) (M := R)
    rw [← Algebra.linearMap_apply R C r]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (trivialToRegular_toLinearMap (R := R) (C := C)) r

name: regular_toSemimoduleCat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem regular_toSemimoduleCat :
    (regular R C).toSemimoduleCat = SemimoduleCat.of R C

name: regular_coact
statement:
@[simp]
theorem regular_coact :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := regular R C) = Coalgebra.comul

name: groupLikeToRegular_apply
statement:
@[simp]

proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨φ, m⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨φ, m, rfl⟩

name: matrixCoefficientSet_subset_of_surjective
statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSet_subset_of_surjective (f : Hom R C M N)

      matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc
  rcases (mem_matrixCoefficientSet_iff (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) c).mp hc with
    ⟨φ, n, rfl⟩
  rcases hf n with ⟨m, rfl⟩

proof:
:= by

  exact Submodule.subset_span (matrixCoefficientSet_subset_of_surjective (R := R) (C := C) f hf hc)

name: matrixCoefficientSet_eq_of_inverse_hom
statement:
theorem matrixCoefficientSet_eq_of_inverse_hom (f : Hom R C M N) (g : Hom R C N M)
    (hfg : ∀ n, f (g n) = n) (hgf : ∀ m, g (f m) = m) :
    matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      matrixCoefficientSet (R := R) (C := C) (M := N)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact matrixCoefficientSet_subset_of_surjective (R := R) (C := C) g
      (fun m => ⟨f m, hgf m⟩)
  · exact matrixCoefficientSet_subset_of_surjective (R := R) (C := C) f
      (fun n => ⟨g n, hfg n⟩)

name: matrixCoefficientSubmodule_eq_of_inverse_hom

    matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =

    letI : Comodule R C M
proof:
:= groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) g
    letI : Comodule R C N := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) g
    letI : Comodule R C P := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := P) g
    ofGroupLike (R := R) (C := C) g (h.comp f) =
      comp (ofGroupLike (R := R) (C := C) g h) (ofGroupLike (R := R) (C := C) g f) :=
  by
    letI : Comodule R C M := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) g
    letI : Comodule R C N := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) g
    letI : Comodule R C P := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := P) g

    ∀ f : Hom R C M N,

  letI : Comodule R C M := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) g

  intro f

name: assoc_rTensor_corestrictCoact
statement:
private theorem assoc_rTensor_corestrictCoact (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (t : M ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.assoc R M D D
        ((corestrictCoact (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) f).rTensor D
          (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id f.toLinearMap t)) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap f.toLinearMap)
        (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C
          ((coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).rTensor C t))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    TensorProduct.assoc R M D D
        ((corestrictCoact (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) f).rTensor D
          (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id f.toLinearMap t))
      =
        TensorProduct.assoc R M D D
          (TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id f.toLinearMap) f.toLinearMap
            ((coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).rTensor C t)) := by
          simp [corestrictCoact, LinearMap.rTensor, TensorProduct.map_map]
    _ =
        TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap f.toLinearMap)
          (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C
            ((coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).rTensor C t)) := by
          exact (TensorProduct.map_map_assoc LinearMap.id f.toLinearMap f.toLinearMap
            ((coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).rTensor C t)).symm

name: comul_lTensor_corestrict_map
statement:
private theorem comul_lTensor_corestrict_map (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (t : M ⊗[R] C) :
    Coalgebra.comul.lTensor M (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id f.toLinearMap t) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap f.toLinearMap)
        (Coalgebra.comul.lTensor M t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul m c =>
      simp [CoalgHomClass.map_comp_comul_apply]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      simpa only [map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy

:= by

     letI : Comodule R E N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := N) (g.comp f)
     (corestrictHom (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := M) (N := N) (g.comp f) h).toLinearMap) =
      (letI : Comodule R D M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) f
       letI : Comodule R D N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := N) f

       (corestrictHom (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := M) (N := N) g

       letI : Comodule R D N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := N) f
       letI : Comodule R E M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := M) g
       letI : Comodule R E N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := N) g
       corestrictHom (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := M) (N := N) g
          (corestrictHom (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) (N := N) f h) m)

name: corestrictHom_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem corestrictHom_comp {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] [Comodule R C P]
    (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : Hom R C M N) (h : Hom R C N P) :
    letI : Comodule R D M
proof:
:= Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) f
    letI : Comodule R D N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := N) f
    letI : Comodule R D P := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := P) f
    corestrictHom (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) (N := P) f (Hom.comp h g) =
      Hom.comp
        (corestrictHom (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := N) (N := P) f h)
        (corestrictHom (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) (N := N) f g) :=
  by
    letI : Comodule R D M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) f
    letI : Comodule R D N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := N) f
    letI : Comodule R D P := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := P) f
    exact Hom.ext fun _ => rfl

theorem groupLike_matrixCoefficient_mem_span_singleton (g : GroupLike R C) (φ : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (m : M) :
    letI : Comodule R C M
proof:
:= groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) g
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m ∈ Submodule.span R ({(g : C)} : Set C) := by
  letI : Comodule R C M := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) g
  rw [matrixCoefficient_groupLike]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton (g : C)))

:= groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) g
    matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) ≤
      Submodule.span R ({(g : C)} : Set C) := by
  letI : Comodule R C M := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) g
  exact matrixCoefficientSubmodule_le (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)

name: groupLike_rankOne_matrixCoefficientSubmodule_eq_span_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupLike_rankOne_matrixCoefficientSubmodule_eq_span_singleton
    (g : GroupLike R C) :
    letI : Comodule R C R
proof:
:= groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := R) g
    matrixCoefficientSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := R) =
      Submodule.span R ({(g : C)} : Set C) := by
  letI : Comodule R C R := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := R) g
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact groupLike_matrixCoefficientSubmodule_le_span_singleton (R := R) (C := C)
      (M := R) g
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    intro c hc
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hc]
    exact Submodule.subset_span (groupLike_mem_rankOne_matrixCoefficientSet (R := R)
      (C := C) g)

counit_lTensor_comp_assoc_symm
statement:
private theorem counit_lTensor_comp_assoc_symm :
    Coalgebra.counit.lTensor (M ⊗[R] C) ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).symm.toLinearMap
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R M C R).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.lTensor M ((Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C)).lTensor C)
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun m x => ?_
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [tmul_add, map_add, hp, hq]

      = (TensorProduct.assoc R M C (C ⊗[R] C)).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.lTensor M ((Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C)).lTensor C)
proof:

  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun m x => ?_
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with

name: assoc_comp_cofreeCoact_rTensor_comp_cofreeCoact
statement:
private theorem assoc_comp_cofreeCoact_rTensor_comp_cofreeCoact :
    TensorProduct.assoc R (M ⊗[R] C) C C ∘ₗ (cofreeCoact R C M).rTensor C ∘ₗ cofreeCoact R C M
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R M C (C ⊗[R] C)).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.lTensor M (TensorProduct.assoc R C C C ∘ₗ
            Coalgebra.comul.rTensor C ∘ₗ Coalgebra.comul)
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun m c => ?_
  simp only [comp_apply, cofreeCoact_tmul, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, lTensor_tmul]
  induction Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C) c using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [tmul_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | tmul a b =>
    simp only [assoc_symm_tmul, rTensor_tmul, cofreeCoact_tmul]
    induction Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C) a using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [tmul_add, map_add, add_tmul, hx, hy]
    | tmul p q => simp [assoc_symm_tmul, assoc_tmul]

statement:
theorem isZero_of_subsingleton (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) [Subsingleton M] : IsZero M where
  unique_to N
proof:
:=
    ⟨{ default := (0 : M ⟶ N)
       uniq := by
        intro f
        ext m
        rw [Subsingleton.elim m (0 : M)]
        exact map_zero f.toLinearMap }⟩
  unique_from N :=
    ⟨{ default := (0 : N ⟶ M)
       uniq := by
        intro f
        ext m
        subsingleton }⟩

name: isRegular_iff_exists_apply_eq
statement:
lemma isRegular_iff_exists_apply_eq :
    IsRegular p ↔
      Function.Surjective p ∧
        ∀ {e e' : E}, p e = p e' → ∃ φ : Deck p, φ.1 e = e'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hreg
    refine ⟨hreg.1, ?_⟩
    intro e e' heq
    let b := p e
    let x : p ⁻¹' {b} := ⟨e, by simp [b]⟩
    let y : p ⁻¹' {b} := ⟨e', by simp [b, heq.symm]⟩
    letI := hreg.2 b
    rcases MulAction.exists_smul_eq (Deck p) x y with ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    exact ⟨φ, by simpa [fiber_smul_coe] using congrArg Subtype.val hφ⟩
  · rintro ⟨hsurj, hpoint⟩
    refine ⟨hsurj, fun b => ?_⟩
    refine MulAction.IsPretransitive.mk ?_
    intro x y
    have hxy : p x.1 = p y.1 := by
      have hx : p x.1 = b := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp x.2
      have hy : p y.1 = b := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp y.2
      rw [hx, hy]
    rcases hpoint hxy with ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    exact ⟨φ, by ext; simpa [fiber_smul_coe] using hφ⟩

name: conj
statement: lemma conj (hreg : IsRegular p) (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) : IsRegular q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun b => ?_⟩
  · intro b
    rcases hreg.1 b with ⟨e, he⟩
    exact ⟨h e, by rw [hpq, he]⟩
  · refine MulAction.IsPretransitive.mk ?_
    intro f f'
    let e : p ⁻¹' {b} := (fiberMap h hpq b).symm f
    let e' : p ⁻¹' {b} := (fiberMap h hpq b).symm f'
    letI := hreg.fiber_isPretransitive b
    rcases MulAction.exists_smul_eq (Deck p) e e' with ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    refine ⟨conjMulEquiv h hpq φ, ?_⟩
    have hmap := congrArg (fiberMap h hpq b) hφ
    rw [fiberMap_smul h hpq φ e] at hmap
    have he : fiberMap h hpq b e = f := by
      simpa [e] using (fiberMap h hpq b).apply_symm_apply f
    have he' : fiberMap h hpq b e' = f' := by
      simpa [e'] using (fiberMap h hpq b).apply_symm_apply f'
    rwa [he, he'] at hmap

name: conj_iff
statement:
lemma conj_iff (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) :
    IsRegular q ↔ IsRegular p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hq
    simpa using hq.conj h.symm (map_symm_eq_of_map_eq h hpq)
  · intro hp
    exact hp.conj h hpq

name: eq_proj_of_orbitRel
statement:
lemma eq_proj_of_orbitRel {e e' : E} (h : MulAction.orbitRel (Deck p) E e e') :

proof:
:= by
  rw [MulAction.orbitRel_apply] at h
  rcases h with ⟨φ, hφ⟩
  rw [← hφ]

name: orbitQuotientToBase_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma orbitQuotientToBase_mk (e : E) :

name: orbitRel_eq_ker_of_exists_apply_eq
statement:
private lemma orbitRel_eq_ker_of_exists_apply_eq
    (hpoint : ∀ {e e' : E}, p e = p e' → ∃ φ : Deck p, φ.1 e = e') :
    MulAction.orbitRel (Deck p) E = Setoid.ker p
proof:
:= by
  ext e e'
  constructor
  · exact eq_proj_of_orbitRel
  · intro heq
    rcases hpoint heq with ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    exact ⟨φ⁻¹, by
      have hinv : φ.1.symm e' = e := by
        rw [← hφ, Homeomorph.symm_apply_apply]
      simpa [smul_eq_apply] using hinv⟩

name: orbitRel_homeomorph_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hee'
    rw [MulAction.orbitRel_apply] at hee' ⊢
    rcases hee' with ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    refine ⟨conjMulEquiv h hpq φ, ?_⟩
    have hφ_apply : φ.1 e' = e := by
      simpa only [smul_eq_apply] using hφ
    calc
      (conjMulEquiv h hpq φ) • h e' = (conjMulEquiv h hpq φ).1 (h e') :=
        smul_eq_apply _ _
      _ = h (φ.1 e') := by rw [conjMulEquiv_apply_coe, h.symm_apply_apply]
      _ = h e := by rw [hφ_apply]
  · intro hff'
    rw [MulAction.orbitRel_apply] at hff' ⊢
    rcases hff' with ⟨ψ, hψ⟩
    refine ⟨(conjMulEquiv h hpq).symm ψ, ?_⟩
    have hψ_apply : ψ.1 (h e') = h e := by
      simpa only [smul_eq_apply] using hψ
    calc
      ((conjMulEquiv h hpq).symm ψ) • e' =
          ((conjMulEquiv h hpq).symm ψ).1 e' := smul_eq_apply _ _
      _ = h.symm (ψ.1 (h e')) := conjMulEquiv_symm_apply_coe h hpq ψ e'
      _ = e := by rw [hψ_apply, h.symm_apply_apply]

name: orbitQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma orbitQuotientEquiv_mk (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (e : E) :
    orbitQuotientEquiv h hpq
      (Quotient.mk'' e : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E) =
        (Quotient.mk'' (h e) : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck q) F)

name: orbitQuotientEquiv_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma orbitQuotientEquiv_symm_mk (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (f : F) :
    (orbitQuotientEquiv h hpq).symm
      (Quotient.mk'' f : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck q) F) =
        (Quotient.mk'' (h.symm f) : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E)

name: orbitQuotientToBase_injective_of_exists_apply_eq
statement:
lemma orbitQuotientToBase_injective_of_exists_apply_eq
    (hpoint : ∀ {e e' : E}, p e = p e' → ∃ φ : Deck p, φ.1 e = e') :
    Function.Injective (orbitQuotientToBase p)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Setoid.lift_injective_iff_ker_eq_of_le
    (r := MulAction.orbitRel (Deck p) E) (f := p)
    (fun _ _ h => eq_proj_of_orbitRel h)).mpr
      (orbitRel_eq_ker_of_exists_apply_eq hpoint).symm

name: orbitQuotient_mk_eq_mk_iff_of_exists_apply_eq
statement:
lemma orbitQuotient_mk_eq_mk_iff_of_exists_apply_eq
    (hpoint : ∀ {e e' : E}, p e = p e' → ∃ φ : Deck p, φ.1 e = e') (e e' : E) :
    (Quotient.mk'' e : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E) = Quotient.mk'' e' ↔
      p e = p e'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa only [orbitQuotientToBase_mk] using congr_arg (orbitQuotientToBase p) h
  · intro h
    apply orbitQuotientToBase_injective_of_exists_apply_eq hpoint
    simpa only [orbitQuotientToBase_mk] using h

name: orbitQuotientEquivBase_conj
statement:
lemma orbitQuotientEquivBase_conj (hreg : IsRegular p) (h : E ≃ₜ F)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (x : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E) :
    (hreg.conj h hpq).orbitQuotientEquivBase
      (orbitQuotientEquiv h hpq x) = hreg.orbitQuotientEquivBase x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | h e =>
      rw [orbitQuotientEquiv_mk, orbitQuotientEquivBase_mk, orbitQuotientEquivBase_mk]
      exact hpq e

name: orbitQuotientEquivBase_conj_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma orbitQuotientEquivBase_conj_mk (hreg : IsRegular p) (h : E ≃ₜ F)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (f : F) :
    (hreg.conj h hpq).orbitQuotientEquivBase
      (Quotient.mk'' f : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck q) F) =
        hreg.orbitQuotientEquivBase
          (Quotient.mk'' (h.symm f) : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← orbitQuotientEquiv_symm_mk h hpq f,
    ← hreg.orbitQuotientEquivBase_conj h hpq ((orbitQuotientEquiv h hpq).symm
      (Quotient.mk'' f : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck q) F)),
    (orbitQuotientEquiv h hpq).apply_symm_apply]

statement:

lemma fiberOrbitClass_eq_mk (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :

name: fiberOrbitClass_eq_iff
statement:
lemma fiberOrbitClass_eq_iff (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :

name: fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_apply (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv h hpq b (fiberOrbitClass e) =

name: fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_symm_apply (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (f : q ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv h hpq b).symm (fiberOrbitClass f) =
      fiberOrbitClass ((fiberMap h hpq b).symm f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv, fiberOrbitClass_eq_mk]
  exact congrArg Quotient.mk''
    (congrArg (fun g : q ⁻¹' {b} ≃ₜ p ⁻¹' {b} => g f)
      (fiberMap_symm (h := h) (hpq := hpq) (b := b))).symm

name: fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_refl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_refl :
    fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv (Homeomorph.refl E) (p := p) (q := p)
        (fun e => by rfl) b =
      Equiv.refl (FiberOrbitQuotient p b)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' x ?_
  intro e
  calc
    fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv (Homeomorph.refl E) (p := p) (q := p)
        (fun e => by rfl) b (Quotient.mk'' e) =
        fiberOrbitClass
          (fiberMap (Homeomorph.refl E) (p := p) (q := p)
            (fun e => by rfl) b e) := by
      simpa [fiberOrbitClass_eq_mk] using
        (fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_apply (Homeomorph.refl E)
          (p := p) (q := p) (fun e => by rfl) (b := b) e)
    _ = (Equiv.refl (FiberOrbitQuotient p b)) (Quotient.mk'' e) := by
      rw [fiberMap_refl]
      rfl

name: fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_trans
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_trans (h : E ≃ₜ F) (k : F ≃ₜ G)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (hqr : ∀ f, r (k f) = q f) :
    fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv (h.trans k) (fun e => by rw [Homeomorph.trans_apply, hqr, hpq]) b =
      (fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv h hpq b).trans (fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv k hqr b)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' x ?_
  intro e
  calc
    fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv (h.trans k) (fun e => by rw [Homeomorph.trans_apply, hqr, hpq])
        b (Quotient.mk'' e) =
        fiberOrbitClass
          (fiberMap (h.trans k) (fun e => by rw [Homeomorph.trans_apply, hqr, hpq]) b e) := by
      simpa [fiberOrbitClass_eq_mk] using
        (fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_apply (h.trans k)
          (p := p) (q := r) (fun e => by rw [Homeomorph.trans_apply, hqr, hpq]) (b := b) e)
    _ = fiberOrbitClass (fiberMap k hqr b (fiberMap h hpq b e)) := by
      rw [← fiberMap_trans (h := h) (k := k) (p := p) (q := q) (r := r)
        (hpq := hpq) (hqr := hqr) (b := b)]
      rfl
    _ = fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv k hqr b (fiberOrbitClass (fiberMap h hpq b e)) := by
      simpa [fiberOrbitClass_eq_mk] using
        (fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_apply k hqr (b := b) (fiberMap h hpq b e)).symm
    _ = ((fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv h hpq b).trans (fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv k hqr b))
        (Quotient.mk'' e) := by
      rw [Equiv.trans_apply]
      congr 1

name: isRegular_iff_surjective_subsingleton_fiberOrbitQuotient

lemma isRegular_iff_surjective_subsingleton_fiberOrbitQuotient :

proof:
:= by
  rw [isRegular_iff]
  refine and_congr_right fun _ => forall_congr' fun b => ?_
  exact MulAction.pretransitive_iff_subsingleton_quotient (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})

name: eq_of_apply_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_apply_eq [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (φ ψ : Deck p) {e : E}
    (h : φ.1 e = ψ.1 e) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Homeomorph.ext
  exact congr_fun
    (hp.eq_of_comp_eq φ.1.continuous ψ.1.continuous
      (by
        ext x
        rw [Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply, map_proj φ x, map_proj ψ x])
      e h)

name: eq_of_smul_eq_smul
statement:
theorem eq_of_smul_eq_smul [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (φ ψ : Deck p) {e : E}

proof:
:=
  eq_of_apply_eq hp φ ψ (by simpa only [smul_eq_apply] using h)

name: isCancelSMul
statement:

name: eq_of_fiber_smul_eq_fiber_smul

theorem eq_of_fiber_smul_eq_fiber_smul [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)

proof:
:= by
  have hcoe : (φ • e : E) = (ψ • e : E) := congrArg Subtype.val h
  rw [fiber_smul_coe, fiber_smul_coe] at hcoe
  exact eq_of_apply_eq hp φ ψ hcoe

name: eq_of_fiberHomeomorph_apply_eq

:=
  eq_of_fiber_smul_eq_fiber_smul hp φ ψ (by simpa using h)

statement:
private lemma conjHomeomorph_mem_deck (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (φ : Deck p) :
    conjHomeomorph h φ.1 ∈ Deck q
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  calc
    q (conjHomeomorph h φ.1 f) = q (h (φ.1 (h.symm f))) := rfl
    _ = p (φ.1 (h.symm f)) := hpq _
    _ = p (h.symm f) := map_proj φ _
    _ = q f := map_symm_eq_of_map_eq h hpq f

name: map_conjHomeomorphMulEquiv_deck
statement:
private lemma map_conjHomeomorphMulEquiv_deck (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) :
    (Deck p).map (conjHomeomorphMulEquiv h : (E ≃ₜ E) →* (F ≃ₜ F)) = Deck q
proof:
:= by
  ext φ
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ψ, hψ, rfl⟩
    exact conjHomeomorph_mem_deck h hpq ⟨ψ, hψ⟩
  · intro hφ
    refine ⟨conjHomeomorph h.symm φ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact conjHomeomorph_mem_deck h.symm (map_symm_eq_of_map_eq h hpq) ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    · ext f
      simp [conjHomeomorph, conjHomeomorphMulEquiv]

name: fiberMap_image_orbit
statement:

theorem fiberMap_image_orbit (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    fiberMap h hpq b '' MulAction.orbit (Deck p) e =
      MulAction.orbit (Deck q) (fiberMap h hpq b e)
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e', ⟨φ, hφ⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [← hφ]
    exact fiberMap_mem_orbit h hpq φ e
  · rintro ⟨ψ, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(conjMulEquiv h hpq).symm ψ • e, ⟨(conjMulEquiv h hpq).symm ψ, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa using fiberMap_smul h hpq ((conjMulEquiv h hpq).symm ψ) e

name: fiberMap_symm_image_orbit

theorem fiberMap_symm_image_orbit (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
